item.title: Editorial: Hampton Roads Ventures continues to neglect its responsibilities
item.description: Norfolk City Council should demand Hampton Roads Ventures invest in local projects in 2026 or sever its ties with the organization.

item.title: Developer to convert 2 more Fort Monroe buildings into apartments
item.description: Gov. Abigail Spanberger said redeveloping old buildings like the ones at Fort Monroe is an essential part of improving Virginia's housing stock and addressing affordability. The project by Richmond-based developer Echelon Resources, will turn two buildings into 85 apartment units.

item.title: Online seller eBay to buy secondhand fashion marketplace Depop from Etsy for $1.2B in cash
item.description: The deal comes five years after Etsy bought Depop for $1.6 billion.

item.title: Air Force One will be repainted as Trump has hinted, US military says
item.description: A “red, white, gold and dark blue paint scheme” will be used for the jet.

item.description: In a video posted to social media, the company urged people to "use extra caution" due to the avalanche danger.

item.title: Man who lived rent-free in New Yorker Hotel, then claimed to own it, pleads guilty to fraud charge
item.description: Mickey Barreto lived for years in the hotel rent-free after invoking an obscure tenant protection.

item.title: House bill gives sex trafficked minors immunity, provides social services
item.description: Senate lawmakers will hear a House bill that provides sex trafficked minors immunity from prostitution charges, and would connect the minors with social services. Del. Convirs-Fowler, D-Virginia Beach, sponsored House Bill 191, which passed the House unanimously earlier in the month.
